purpose: Three preview variants of selected grand carnival concept
prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE landscape 16:9 high-quality 3D game environment concept for Neverland amusement park. It is a GLAMOROUS GRAND CARNIVAL, richly detailed and festive. STRICT dominant palette: rich carnival RED, warm golden YELLOW, deep emerald GREEN, with small ivory/wood accents. No dominant purple or blue. Sophisticated color balance, not a Christmas market: NO Christmas trees, Santa, snow, holiday decorations. Beautiful modeled architecture, dimensional PBR surfaces, warm bulb lighting, attractive soft shadows and atmosphere. Eye-level first-person view, wide 24mm lens, looking from an arrival deck into a clearly walkable park boulevard; Ferris wheel to the left, ornate carousel to right, pirate ship swing beside the entrance, spinning teacups and mirror-maze pavilion further back. Recognizable amusement rides dominate, not generic castles. Ticket booths, decorative railings, benches, planters, striped canopies, pennants, layered marquees, strings of bulbs, patterned paving, dense lovely environmental detail. Luminous peach-and-mint late afternoon sky, golden lights visible, no dark night. No characters, no people, no text, no logos, no HUD. This is a polished art-direction proposal for a walkable 3D game, not a flat illustration, low-poly placeholder, collage or existing screenshot. VARIANT 1: CLASSIC RED CARNIVAL, bold and playful yet elegant. Dominant cherry red and butter-yellow striped tents and canopies, emerald ironwork and green glazed roofs. Strong graphic carnival rhythm, scalloped tent trim, radiant sunburst ornaments, large round warm yellow bulbs around all ride silhouettes. Ferris wheel has bright red spokes, gold rim and emerald gondolas. Carousel red/yellow canopy with gold carved horses. Long gently curving boulevard with red/cream fan-pattern paving and symmetrical golden lamp rows, cheerful dense flower beds. Unified extravagant classic fairground with very readable ride forms. Camera near straight central boulevard, grounded continuous paths.

VARIANT 2: EMERALD ROYAL GARDEN CARNIVAL, lush and romantic opulence. Dominant deep emerald green pavilions and glazed domes with golden-yellow Art Nouveau ironwork, vivid crimson draped canopies and abundant red roses. Grand lace-like iron entry arches, sculptural topiary, terraced flower beds, narrow reflecting fountains, ivory stone and gold mosaic paths. Ferris wheel green/gold with red gondolas, ornate gilded carousel with red velvet canopy. Rides nestled in elaborate garden plazas linked by broad winding paths. Clearly a glittering luxury amusement park, not just a botanical garden. Bright red, yellow and green are evident throughout. Eye-level view from a curving ornamental bridge into the park, lush layered depth.

VARIANT 3: GRAND THEATRICAL FESTIVAL CARNIVAL, most spectacular and theatrical. Broad red-and-gold radial plaza leading through a huge multilevel carnival marquee arch (not a castle), emerald-green towers, layered crimson drapes, oversized golden sunburst crowns and ribbon-shaped illuminated sculptures, jewel-red and green facade panels, golden-yellow bulb outlines, thick festive pennants overhead. Monumental Ferris wheel with yellow illuminated rings and alternating red/green gondolas, carousel resembles an ornate open-air opera stage in red, green and gold, teacups in jewel colors. Theatrical park planning with a central fountain and radiating walkable paths, more architectural height and dramatic scale than the other versions.
